fields.summary_ko.0: Intuitive Surgical (ISRG) rose 7.8% over the past six months but significantly lagged the medical device industry's 28.7% gain.
fields.summary_ko.1: Q3 2026 earnings showed 22% revenue growth YoY and adjusted EPS of $3.00 (25% YoY increase), though GAAP EPS declined to $1.49 due to a $450M antitrust settlement.
fields.summary_ko.2: da Vinci and Ion platform procedures increased 15% YoY, and da Vinci 5 system installations grew to 315 units (versus 240 units in the prior year), maintaining growth momentum.
